polishes.name: 2 Straws 1 Julius
polishes.collection: our Meet Me at the Mall
polishes.description: Meeting your crush at the mall never felt so sweet - your heart rate quickens, you giggle nervously, and your fingertips brush as you both reach for your shared bevvy at the same time... 2 Straws 1 Julius is a neon orange lacquer with pink shimmer. This polish is part of our Meet Me at the Mall collection.

polishes.name: Android Dreams
polishes.description: Dreams are just corrupted files flickering behind artificial eyelids. Soft white static, lit from within by a cold blue pulse. Android Dreams is a semi-sheer white lacquer filled with extreme blue shimmer and a touch of tiny holographic glitter. This polish is part of our cyberpunk Digital Dystopia collection.

polishes.name: Bad Reputation
polishes.description: History tried to remember them as warnings to never step outside the lines. If history has taught us anything, it’s never trust the ones powerful enough to control the narrative. 🖤Bad Reputation. Five showstopping magnetic polishes, five legends, and one very overdue correction. 🧲✨⚓️ A Thousand Ships🎨 Chiaroscuro 🧜♀️ La Sirène👑 Off With Her Head🐍 The Last Pharaoh

polishes.name: Badass Glass Quick Dry Top Coat
polishes.description: Glossy. Fast. Drama-free. Badass Glass is your mani’s final flex — glossy, quick-drying, and zero patience required. Add our Strong Claws base coat to the mix and get both for less: Strong Claws + Badass Glass

polishes.name: Banana Taffy
polishes.description: Banana Taffy is a neon yellow crème polish. 🍌 Don’t get it twisted.

polishes.name: Beneath the Palms
polishes.description: Somewhere between the sway of the palms and the shimmer of pool water, this color lives. Beneath the Palms is a light green lacquer with a pink-to-gold shift and a glint of microfine holographic glitter. This polish is part of our Roadside Oasis collection.

polishes.name: Berry Goth
polishes.description: We have paused production of this polish as we research possible solutions for pigment stability issues. If you have experienced problems with this shade, please reach out to customer service at help@prismparade.com Macabre at the mall - decked out all in black, face powdered to high heaven, and headed to Hot Topic. Berry Goth is a neon purple lacquer with large particle blue shimmer that glows blue in the dark.

polishes.name: Bloodlust
polishes.description: Bloodlust is six vampy shades turning any time into something darker, hungrier. Collection Includes: 🫦 Turn Me🩸Vieux Sang💦 Tainted Thirst💃 Fangtease⚰️ Immortal Desire🧛 Say It. Out Loud.

polishes.name: Candle Flickers Out
polishes.description: The candle was lit when you walked in. It isn't anymore. 🕯️😱 *insert jump scare* Candle Flickers Out is a black jelly polish with gold and copper shifting flakies and gold reflective glitter.

polishes.name: Chiaroscuro
polishes.description: The same world that commissioned his genius criminalized his existence. History gave him the last word. 🖤 Named for the light and shadow Leonardo bent to his will, Chiaroscuro is a green-khaki polish with electric blue magnetic pigment, gold shifting shimmer, and holographic glitter.

polishes.name: Clairevoyant
polishes.collection: our Meet Me at the Mall
polishes.description: There's only one store you need if accessorizing is on the agenda. Rows upon rows of rings, necklaces, bracelets, earrings, purses, and knick-knacks to help you showcase your true Y2K style. Clairevoyant is a magenta lacquer with green-indigo-violet shimmer. This polish is part of our Meet Me at the Mall collection.

polishes.name: Cotton Candy
polishes.description: Cotton Candy is a neon blue crème polish. 🍬 Light. Airy. Loud AF.

polishes.name: Cybernetic - Holographic Topper
polishes.description: More machine than manicure. This one’s all chrome, chaos, and cybernetic flash. Cybernetic is a chunky holographic shard-flakie topper that looks out of this world over any of our polishes or on its own. This polish is part of our cyberpunk Digital Dystopia collection.

polishes.name: Dead Reckoning
polishes.description: As ruthless as a broadside attack and as volatile as mutiny, this shade charts a course of its own - straight into battle. Dead Reckoning is a deep navy blue based polish with gold to orange shimmer.

polishes.name: Don't Go Inside
polishes.description: Every town has one. The house on the corner nobody talks about, the one with shadows in the windows that seem to hide something far worse than anything you could imagine.Don't Go Inside is five dark, gothic shades born from that house. Candle Flickers OutHidden In the StairwellNot Alone In HereSomething In the CornerWhat the Walls KeepEnter if you dare!

polishes.name: Double Door - Pbe Overpour
polishes.description: Double Door is one of our 2026 Polish and Beauty Expo exclusive polishes - limited quantities available! This polish can be used as a topper, or layered in 2-3 coats to build up as a chunky glitter and metallic flakie bomb (as shown.) This polish has a clear base, green and aqua holographic shards, and large and micro holographic glitters.

polishes.name: Electric Horizon
polishes.description: There was a time, they say, when you didn’t need a filter to see color like this. I don’t know if I believe them — but every once in a while, the sim gets it almost right. Electric Horizon is a bright blue based lacquer with super glowy green shimmer, giving it a distinctive cyan hue. This polish is part of our cyberpunk Digital Dystopia collection.

polishes.name: Ember in the Ice
polishes.description: In the stillness of cold, something dares to burn.Ember In the Ice is a shifty glitter bomb polish that includes pink-to-blue shimmer, green and blue reflective glitter and gold holographic glitter.

polishes.name: Fangtease
polishes.description: She won’t bite… unless you ask nicely.Fangtease is a juicy purple jelly base with glowing chameleon flakies that shift pink, purple, and blue with every move.

polishes.name: Fathoms Below
polishes.description: Approaching the deepest dark, the sea gleams with color's no sailor's eyes have known, save those claimed by a watery grave. Turquoise shifting to green, then to indigo, with glints like sunken treasure, Fathoms Below is the mystery the tides will never tell. Fathoms Below is a turquoise based lacquer with green to indigo shimmer and holographic glitter.

polishes.name: Fireside Bowl - Pbe Overpour
polishes.description: Fireside Bowl is one of our 2026 Polish and Beauty Expo exclusive polishes - limited quantities available! This polish can be used as a topper, or layered in 2-3 coats to build up as a chunky glitter and metallic flakie bomb (as shown.) This polish has a clear base, red and orange holographic shards, and large and micro holographic glitters.

polishes.name: Food Court Flirt
polishes.collection: our Meet Me at the Mall
polishes.description: Pretzel? Yes. Meat/cheese on a stick? Absolutely. Nothing says mall like classic food court grub, and the eye-searing yellow of this polish will have you craving at least a very large lemonade. Food Court Flirt is a neon yellow lacquer with green shimmer than glows green in the dark. This polish is part of our Meet Me at the Mall collection.

polishes.name: Fortune's Folly
polishes.description: Coveted and cursed, there is a legend of a treasure that dazzles as brightly as it deceives. It’s the kind of prize that will drag a ship to ruin and captivate the crew for eternity. Fortune’s Folly is a turquoise and gold metallic flake polish with a dash of holographic sparkle.

polishes.name: Fountains + Photobooths
polishes.collection: our Meet Me at the Mall
polishes.description: Meet me by the fountain - we'll toss a quick coin in and make a wish, then head to the photobooth so we can remember this day 4ever. Fountains + Photobooths is a neon blue lacquer with pinkish purple shimmer. This polish is part of our Meet Me at the Mall collection.

polishes.name: Frostborne
polishes.description: Beneath the shimmer of an endless winter sky, a queen rises. ❄️✨Frostborne is our ultimate winter lineup of six icy shimmery polishes, laced with soft sparkles, reflective glitter, and frozen magic. 👸 Ice Queen🐉 Shiverscale💋 Winter’s Kiss🌲 Frozen Hollow🌙 Moonlit Coronation🧊 Ember in the Ice

polishes.name: Frozen Hollow
polishes.other_colors: Solar, Glow in the Dark, Topper, Top Coat
polishes.description: Beneath the frozen canopy, an ancient forest brims with life. Frozen Hollow is a frostbitten sage lacquer with glowy green shimmer and microfine holographic glitter.

polishes.name: Ghosted - Glow-in-the-dark Topper
polishes.description: Ghosted is a blue glow in the dark topper. Shake the bottle vigorously for 30 seconds before use. We recommend using the topper over other shades, or on its own, and then using a quick dry top coat on top. The polish will glow best when charged under a black light for 30+ seconds, but other lights and sunlight will also charge the polish.

polishes.name: Gilded Grudge
polishes.description: A dagger's gleam in lantern light. Shadows stir below deck. By dawn, the captain lay dead and the crew had earned their treacherous treasure. Gilded Grudge is a bronze gold lacquer with large particle gold shimmer.

polishes.name: Glitter Tamer
polishes.description: Get rid of the grit. Glitter Tamer is is a barrier layer of polish between your shade and your quick dry top coat. The plump and juicy formula works its way between glitters to create a smoothing effect.

polishes.name: Golden Mirage
polishes.description: The sun’s been in our eyes for miles now. Every ripple on the horizon looks like water, every glint a promise. But this one — this flicker of gold — feels different. Maybe this time, it’s not a mirage. Golden Mirage is a bronze-leaning yellow gold lacquer with shifty gold shimmer that appears green at extreme angles. This polish is part of our Roadside Oasis collection.

polishes.name: Gummy Bear
polishes.description: Gummy Bear is a neon purple crème polish. 💜 Cute. Chewy. Slightly feral.

polishes.name: Hidden in the Stairwell
polishes.description: Logically, the stairwell is the safest room in the house. No corners, no closets, nowhere for anything to hide. Wait. Shh. Did you hear that? Hidden In the Stairwell is a black jelly polish with purple-teal-blue color shifting flakies and holographic glitter.

polishes.name: Hudson
polishes.description: Hudson is a deep blue lacquer shimmering with electric blue glow and flecks of gold glitter—classic, cool, and effortlessly charming. Inspired by Rock Hudson, Hollywood’s leading man and silver screen heartthrob. $2 of sales from Hudson will be donated to the Elizabeth Taylor AIDS Foundation. This polish is part of our Golden Age Glam collection.

polishes.name: Ice Queen
polishes.description: Cold to the touch, irresistible to the eye, she’s calm, cool, collected and ready to frost your fingertips. Ice Queen is a baby blue lacquer with glacial blue shimmer and microfine holographic glitter.

polishes.name: Immortal Desire
polishes.description: A craving that never dies.Immortal Desire is a purple based polish with large particle pink and orange shimmer.

polishes.name: La Sirène
polishes.description: She couldn't get a hotel room in her own country. So she became the most famous woman in the world and a spy for the French Resistance. 🖤 In Paris Josephine Baker became La Sirène. La Sirène is a shimmery magenta polish with purple-pink shifting magnetic pigment and holographic glitter.

polishes.name: Lena
polishes.description: Elegant. Defiant. Unforgettable. Lena is a navy-based polish cloaked in shifty green shimmer that swings from gold to emerald to moody blue, depending on the light. Just like Lena Horne herself — it’s always got something to say. This polish is part of our Golden Age Glam collection.

polishes.name: Leviathan
polishes.description: A shadow moves over the deck and a creeping sense of dread overtakes everyone on board. The beast has risen from the depths to seize you whole. One glittering pull and you’re dragged beneath the waves forever. Leviathan is a blue-based polish with gold to green shifting shimmer and holographic glitter.

polishes.name: Made U a Mixtape
polishes.collection: our Meet Me at the Mall
polishes.description: Songs so carefully selected you could cry (okay, you totally cried a few times making this tape.) Maybe they'll finally realize you're the one? IDK but this mixtape lives on forever. Made U A Mixtape is a teal lacquer with fuchsia-gold-orange shimmer. This polish is part of our Meet Me at the Mall collection.

polishes.name: Mallbrat
polishes.collection: our Meet Me at the Mall
polishes.description: Mallrat meets Brat in our eyeball scorching take on neon green. Listen, at Prism Parade it's always Brat Summer. We just could not resist making our own rendition. We'll always Party 4 U, at the mall or not. <3 Mallbrat is a neon green lacquer with red to gold shimmer. This polish is part of our Meet Me at the Mall collection.

polishes.name: Marilyn
polishes.description: Marilyn is a fiery magenta shimmer that steals the spotlight — just like the iconic bombshell who defined an era. This polish is part of our Golden Age Glam collection.

polishes.name: Moonlit Coronation
polishes.description: Under the silver light of the midwinter moon, the crown settles at last. Moonlit Coronation is an indigo based polish with intoxicating pinkish-red shimmer and filled with silver reflective glitter.

polishes.name: Nan
polishes.description: Beneath archways of chrome and concrete, a neon beacon pulses like a heartbeat — synthetic light dancing across scarred concrete. Neon Arcade is a hot pink lacquer filled with supercharged blue aurora shimmer. This polish is part of our cyberpunk Digital Dystopia collection.

polishes.name: Noir - One Coat Black
polishes.description: She was trouble — the kind that shows up in one coat. Noir is our inky, one-coat crème: smooth, dramatic, and just a little dangerous. It goes on easy, dries fast, and leaves a shine even this city can’t dull. She thickens with time (as most good stories do). Just add a drop of thinner, and get back to the case.

polishes.name: Not Alone in Here
polishes.description: There's no one else in the house. At least, that's what you keep telling yourself as the shadow in the corner shifts. 👤 Not Alone In Here is a black based polish with purple shimmer, lavender glitter, and silver reflective glitter.

polishes.name: Off with Her Head
polishes.description: A powerful man wants her gone, so he accuses her of adultery, incest, witchcraft, and treason. And somehow the whole world believes it. Classic. Anne Boleyn didn't break. 🖤 Off With Her Head is a shimmery fuchsia with lime green shifting magnetic pigment and holographic glitter.

polishes.name: Poolside
polishes.description: This must be paradise — the air heavy with heat, a cocktail sweating in your hand, and the sky so blue it almost feels fake. Sunlight skips across the pool’s surface, casting gold over aqua like a dream you never want to wake from. Poolside is an aqua blue lacquer with larger particle gold shimmer and a touch of microfine holographic glitter. This polish is part of our Roadside Oasis collection.

polishes.name: Push Pop
polishes.description: Push Pop is a neon orange crème polish. 🧡 Bright enough to cause a scene (probably will).

polishes.name: Replacement Brushes
polishes.description: 6 pack of brushes with caps! Select paddle or original fan brush styles. These brushes and caps are from our manufacturer and aren't tested or intended for use with other bottles.

polishes.name: Say It. Out Loud.
polishes.collection: Shown here over various shades from our Bloodlust
polishes.description: Sparkle like Edward in sunlight.Say It. Out Loud. is a silver reflective glitter and microfine holographic topper. Shown here over various shades from our Bloodlust collection, black, white, and nude nails.

polishes.name: Shiverscale
polishes.description: Cold fire runs beneath the skin of our sleeping ice dragon. Is it finally time for her to awaken? Shiverscale is a lavender-hued lacquer with mesmerizing green shimmer, laced with purple reflective glitter and microfine holo.

polishes.name: Shortcake
polishes.description: Shortcake is a neon pink crème polish. 🍰 Smooth. Creamy. Baked in chaos.

polishes.name: Something in the Corner
polishes.description: It's just shadow. It's just the light. It's just your eyes playing tricks. It's just— Something In the Corner is a black jelly polish with deep dark green shimmer that shifts to blue at extreme angles.

polishes.name: Sour Sucker
polishes.description: Sour Sucker is a neon green crème polish. 🍏 Face-puckeringly bright.

polishes.name: Sugar Rush
polishes.description: Sugar Rush is seven unapologetic neon crèmes with full sweets aisle energy. 🍭 Collection Includes: 💜 Gummy Bear 🍏 Sour Sucker 🍰 Shortcake 🍬 Cotton Candy 🧡 Push Pop 🍌 Banana Taffy 🍉 Watermelon Crush

polishes.name: Tainted Thirst
polishes.description: When hunger turns unholy. Tainted Thirst is a muted grape based polish with large particle blue to green shifting shimmer and microfine holographic glitter.

polishes.name: The Last Pharaoh
polishes.description: Two thousand years of being called a seductress when she was a mathematician, military strategist, and one of the most politically sophisticated rulers of her era. The Last Pharaoh is Cleopatra. A shimmery green polish with gold-orange shifting magnetic pigment and holographic glitter.

polishes.name: Turn Me
polishes.description: To be turned is to know eternity. Turn Me is a bright blood red with gold-orange-red shimmer. Powerful, intoxicating, and impossible to ignore, this shade marks the moment everything changes.

polishes.name: Urban Wasteland
polishes.description: Where machine and ruin blur, color bleeds through: glitching reds, artificial sunsets, and neon ghosts on the skyline. Urban Wasteland is a turquoise-based polish with pinkish-red shimmer and silver and teal holographic glitter. This polish is part of our cyberpunk Digital Dystopia collection.

polishes.name: Vieux Sang
polishes.description: Old blood, ancient thirst. Vieux Sang is a purple-leaning antique red lacquer with soft gold to red shimmer.

polishes.name: Watermelon Crush
polishes.description: Watermelon Crush is a neon red-orange crème polish. 🍉 Juicy. Sticky. Slightly threatening.

polishes.name: What the Walls Keep
polishes.description: Someone buried it in the walls and hoped it would never be found. There it waited. Until now. What the Walls Keep is a dark red jelly polish with yellow-orange-red color shifting flakies.

polishes.name: Whispers From the Deep
polishes.description: The siren’s song - soft at first, then impossible to resist. As her voice coils around our cursed crew, will they be lured one by one below the glittering waves? Whispers From the Deep is a purple lacquer with fuchsia-gold-orange shimmer laced with gold microflakes.

polishes.name: Winter's Kiss
polishes.description: The blush of that first touch, the quiet heat that builds despite the cold. Winter’s Kiss is a soft, shimmery polish with triple pink shifting shimmers and tiny flecks of blue laced throughout. It can appear a soft pearly white, light lavender or even a light green at certain angles, making this one of our most unique formulas to date. Please note: Minimal staining can occur with this polish. We recommend using a base coat to minimize. Small stains can also be removed with cuticle remover.
